The machine is actively scrubbing a white carpet, lifting visible dirt and grime from the fibers. The cleaning solution, likely a foamy detergent, is visibly spreading across the carpet's surface, creating a lather that helps in the cleaning process. The machine moves in a single direction, covering the carpet area. The background remains consistent throughout the frames, focusing solely on the cleaning action without any additional elements or distractions.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a carpet cleaning process using a specialized machine labeled "R2 - CLEAN2." The machine is actively scrubbing a white carpet, which appears to be heavily soiled, as evidenced by the visible dirt and grime being lifted from the fibers. The cleaning solution, likely a foamy detergent, is visibly spreading across the carpet's surface, creating a lather that helps in the cleaning process. The machine moves methodically back and forth, ensuring thorough coverage of the carpet area. The background remains consistent throughout the frames, focusing solely on the cleaning action without any additional elements or distractions. The video emphasizes the effectiveness of the cleaning equipment in tackling the carpet's dirt, highlighting the transformation from a dirty state to a cleaner one.
caption: The video showcases a close-up of a white rug laid flat and coated in a wet, soapy foam layer, with a stainless-steel cleaning head on a long angled pole resting on its surface. The head, carrying a mass of white foam along its leading edge and a blue label on one side, sweeps steadily from the center-right toward the left edge, rotating so the label passes out of view and the bolted side plate faces the camera. As it drags across the rug, the horizontal foam ridge behind the head is visibly displaced and reshaped, and the bristle-foam mass shifts against the metal housing. Near the left margin the head continues its pass. In the final frames it angles slightly back toward the center, bringing the blue label partly into view again, the sweeping motion already underway at the start and still ongoing at the end.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
